name: Shatter the World (Costs 2 Actions)
description: The creature causes crystal spikes to erupt from the ground in a 30-foot radius centered on it. The area becomes difficult terrain until the start of its next turn. Any creature, other than the creature, takes 9 (2d8) piercing damage for every 5 feet it moves on those spikes.
